title: Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Provision
content:
## 1. Right to reinstate

A lapsed Term Life Insurance policy may be reinstated on the owner's signed reinstatement application.

## 2. Reinstatement window

The reinstatement application must be signed no later than the end of the reinstatement window, which is the lapse date plus the product's reinstatement window in months. The window end is found by adding the number of calendar months to the lapse date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; an application signed on the window end is in time. The clock starts from the lapse date on the policy record and is compared with the signed date on the reinstatement application.

| Lapse date (hypothetical) | Window | Window end | Signed on window end | Signed the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2024 | 60 months | 10 June 2029 | in time | not in time |
| 29 February 2024 | 36 months | 28 February 2027 (no 29 February in 2027) | in time | not in time |

A lapsed policy past its reinstatement window cannot be reinstated; the insured may only apply for new coverage.

## 3. Evidence of insurability

The evidence required is read from the product's evidence ladder by the number of calendar days from the lapse date to the application's signed date: none, a statement of good health signed by the insured, or full underwriting.

## 4. Approval

The policy is reinstated only on a reinstatement application whose request status is approved. An application needing no evidence or a statement of good health is approved by policy service once the statement, where required, is signed; an application needing full underwriting is submitted to underwriting and the policy stays lapsed until underwriting approves it.

## 5. Reinstatement amount (retired clause)

The clause "the reinstatement amount is every installment that would have fallen due from the paid-to date at lapse through the reinstatement date, each billed at the premium in effect when it would have fallen due, plus simple interest at the product's reinstatement interest rate on each installment for the actual calendar days from its due date to the reinstatement date over 365, rounded to the cent per installment" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## 6. On the reinstatement date

On the reinstatement date the installments are billed and paid. Where the product provides that reinstatement restarts contestability (every tier does), statements in the reinstatement application are contestable for the product's contestability period from the reinstatement date.

superseded_clauses: The reinstatement amount is every installment that would have fallen due from the paid-to date at lapse through the reinstatement date, each billed at the premium in effect when it would have fallen due, plus simple interest at reinstatement_interest_rate on each installment for the actual calendar days from its due date to the reinstatement date over 365, rounded to the cent per installment.
